note: Apply one entry at a time, run its named tests, then restore the exact bytes. 'lab' entries edit files under lab/a1-a8-hardening. 'runtime-local' entries edit Runtime source temporarily on the test machine only; restore them byte-identical (compare SHA-256) and never commit them. A build failure, harness error or timeout does not count as caught: the named test must run and fail at a listed fail_needle (default: the refusal assertion). exit:timeout and exit:None are NOT CAUGHT.
